title: Medallion Architecture Consolidation with Integrated Vector & Knowledge Graph Products
description: Unify all archive domains (Legislation, Gazette, CKAN data.govt.nz, Health/MoH, Treasury, Feeds/Social) into a multi-tiered Medallion Data Architecture (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold) aligned with global-medicines-atlas. Subsume graph and vector capabilities into deterministic Gold-tier analytical models (DuckDB, LanceDB, DCAT-AP/RO-Crate/Croissant).
